name: Christopher Pyne I move: That this bill be now read a third time. Andrew Leigh Mr Speaker— Tony Smith No, members on my right will cease interjecting. The Manager of Opposition Business. Tony Burke Given that no-one was speaking and no-one had the call at the time that the Leader of the House moved that motion, I simply ask your advice as to who it is who will no longer be heard if that motion is carried. Tony Smith The Manager of Opposition Business is right: no-one had the call. I call the Leader of the House. Christopher Pyne I move: That the motion be put. Tony Smith The question now is that this bill be read a third time. Question agreed to. Bill read a third time.
